# Chip generation — canonical option pipeline (directive addendum, 2026-08-05)

> Sequencing authority: [CANONICAL_MIGRATION_DIRECTIVE.md](CANONICAL_MIGRATION_DIRECTIVE.md) (Phase B–F master directive). This document is the detail layer.

**Chips are a projection of canonical semantic state.** Never generated by
parsing Arnie's rendered sentence, regex-matching question text, hardcoded
small/medium/large tiers, client-side inference, or per-screen logic.

    unresolved semantic field
      → candidate evidence
      → normalized candidate distribution
      → deterministic option selection
      → typed semantic patches
      → rendered labels
      → client presentation

This document sequences that INTO the existing migration — it does not delay
quick-log verification (closed: see QUICK_LOG_PROMOTION_RECORD.md) and does not
trigger a broad clarification rewrite. It composes with
[CLARIFICATION_MIGRATION.md](CLARIFICATION_MIGRATION.md): that doc owns the
question/answer lifecycle; this one owns where options COME FROM.

Measured repo-wide by AST (C9), not by an allowlist of files and one spelling.
The first version of the ratchet froze five files matching the literal
`"options":`, which is why the two relay rows below shipped uncounted and the
contract document overclaimed on the day it was written.

| producer | field | semantic source | output shape | deletion milestone |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `food_turn` `_chip_options` / `"options"` sites ×7 | mixed | portion ontology, brand shelves, `_stated_options`, `_PREPARATION_OPTIONS`, piece-weight tables | flat label lists | replaced per field type at Phases H/L; deleted at N |
| `conversation.py` write-side relay ×1 | — | copies into pending payload | loose lists | dies when the interaction payload ships (B-1) |
| `context_builder.py` read-side relay ×1 | — | re-reads the SAME stash onto the chat wire, truncated to 4 | loose lists | dies with the write-side relay (B-1) |
| `clarify_ui.py` `as_dict` ×1 | staged asks | staged-pipeline UI model (dormant) | UI payload | absorbed at Phase H |
| `AmbiguityOption(...)` ×5 (`food_pipeline` ×4, `staged_codec` ×1) | staged asks | ambiguity candidates | label+confidence, no patch | absorbed into `CandidateValue` at Phase D |
| `QuickReplyEngine.swift` (iOS repo) | all | **Arnie's rendered prose** | client-parsed chips | disabled when interaction payload present (B-1), deleted at N |

Counted but NOT debt, named so the ratchet can tell them apart:
`validators.py` ×2 is a materiality diagnostic whose "options" are the two
candidate numbers that disagree — not a wire payload; `semantics.py` ×1 is
`UnresolvedField.to_payload`, the canonical replacement, and its count RISES
as the debt rows fall.

## The evidence hierarchy (Phase D/E — matches the resolution directive)

    1 user history   2 OFF   3 USDA   4 web evidence   5 validated ontology
    6 model proposal (only after stronger evidence is insufficient; never emits
      final chip strings)   7 unresolved/free text

Provenance weighting for history candidates:

    USER_STATED 1.00 · USER_CONFIRMED 0.90 · USER_SELECTED 0.75 ·
    CATALOG 0.55 · MODE_DEFAULT 0.20 · MODEL_ESTIMATE 0.05-or-excluded

## Selection properties (Phase F)

Score ≈ probability × information gain × materiality × source confidence ×
contextual relevance ÷ user effort. **Not top-3-by-probability** — that yields
near-duplicates. Numeric quantities use weighted distribution representatives
(≈P25/P50/P85) **selected from real candidates**: `3 oz / 5 oz / 8 oz / Other`,
never `4.8 / 5.0 / 5.2`. Always preserve a free-text route (C15).

## Wire contract (Phases H/J)

A chip tap submits `operation_id · revision · field_id · option_id` — nothing
else. The server loads the stored patch. Labels are never semantics (C11).
